results.content: *ESRDPayment@cms.hhs.gov* or Nicolas Brock at (410) 786-5148 for issues related to the ESRD Prospective Payment System (PPS) and coverage and payment for renal dialysis services furnished to individuals with acute kidney injury (AKI). This rule finalizes changes related to the End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) Prospective Payment System (PPS), payment for renal dialysis services furnished to individuals with acute kidney injury (AKI), the Conditions for Coverage for ESRD facilities, the ESRD Quality Incentive Program (QIP), and the ESRD Treatment Choices (ETC) Model. Section 808(b) of the TPEA amended section 1834 of the Act by adding a new subsection (r) that provides for payment for renal dialysis services furnished by renal dialysis facilities or providers of services paid under section 1881(b)(14) of the Act to individuals with AKI at the ESRD PPS base rate beginning January 1, 2017. 6.   *https://www.cms.gov/​files/​document/​mm13445-esrd-acute-kidney-injury-dialysis-cy-2024-updates.pdf.*. *https://www.cms.gov/​files/​document/​end-stage-renal-disease-prospective-payment-system-technical-expert-panel-summary-report-may-2020.pdf*. *https://www.cms.gov/​medicare/​payment/​prospective-payment-systems/​end-stage-renal-disease-esrd* and *https://www.cms.gov/​files/​document/​including-oral-only-drugs-esrd-pps-bundled-payment.pdf.*. *https://www.cms.gov/​files/​document/​including-oral-only-drugs-esrd-pps-bundled-payment.pdf*. *https://www.cms.gov/​files/​document/​end-stage-renal-disease-prospective-payment-system-technical-expert-panel-summary-report-april-2021.pdf*. *https://www.cms.gov/​files/​document/​end-stage-renal-disease-prospective-payment-system-technical-expert-panel-summary-report-april-2021.pdf*. *https://www.cms.gov/​files/​document/​end-stage-renal-disease-prospective-payment-system-technical-expert-panel-summary-report-april-2021.pdf*. *https://www.cms.gov/​medicare/​payment/​prospective-payment-systems/​end-stage-renal-disease-esrd/​esrd-prospective-payment-system-esrd-pps-overview-claims-based-monitoring-program*. *https://www.cms.gov/​medicare/​payment/​prospective-payment-systems/​end-stage-renal-disease-esrd/​esrd-prospective-payment-system-esrd-pps-overview-claims-based-monitoring-program*.
